The best and brightest representing South Carolina during the Artemis II mission launch!

@ClemsonUniv’s Vanessa Wyche and Charlie Blackwell-Thompson carried their Tiger pride to @NASA.

Proud to see the tremendous accomplishments of fellow South Carolinians!


Clemson University (@ClemsonUniv)

Did you know? The Director of @NASA_Johnson, Vanessa Wyche ’85, M ’87, is also an alumna! Artemis II was passed from Tiger to Tiger!

The Working Families Tax Cut Act looks out for all Americans. Families and individuals in the lowest income bracket will see a 15% tax cut compared to previous years.

@SenateGOP is working to keep the promise of the American Dream within reach!
Wishing all those who celebrate a happy Passover!

Today marks a historic step for @NASA with the launch of the Artemis II mission sending astronauts around the moon for the first time in 50 years!

NASA continues to lead the way in space exploration and scientific discovery. Wishing our astronauts a safe and successful mission!


NASA (@NASA)

Grateful for the continued work of @SCcommerce to expand opportunity across the Palmetto State!

Hardworking farmers across South Carolina are struggling with varying labor costs and a government wage rule that hasn’t kept up with reality. Marilyn Harris, CEO of the Beaufort Black Chamber of Commerce, brings decades of leadership from military service to the halls of government.

Marilyn holds multiple master’s degrees and has worked in the U.S. House of Representatives, Department of Veterans Affairs, Department of the Army, and the White House.

She founded Mimi’s Closet, providing essential supplies to students in need, and her servant leadership continues to strengthen businesses, lives, and communities across South Carolina.

Every American deserves a fair shot to build financial security.

Today’s @USDOL proposal helps expand 401(k) investment options so workers, including families across South Carolina, have more opportunities to grow their retirement savings.


U.S. Department of Labor (@USDOL)

Washington bureaucrats shouldn't determine how the American people invest their own 401(k)s.

Happy National Doctors’ Day!

With a nephew who’s a doctor, I’ve seen the dedication, skill, and commitment it takes to care for Americans’ health. Grateful for all the doctors caring for patients across South Carolina and the nation!

Happy National Mom and Pop Business Owners Day!

The hard work and dedication of small business owners help keep South Carolina thriving. Today we celebrate their grit, perseverance, and American spirit!
On National Vietnam War Veterans Day, we honor the brave men and women who served our nation during the Vietnam War. Their courage, commitment, and sacrifice set an example for all Americans.
